comparison.objective: Release a spring clamp and retrieve a screwdriver into a verified left-hand grasp.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate the clamp before pulling, transfer/control the tool, and maintain opposing loaded fingertip contacts.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires the freed tool held over the marker by both exact left fingertips for one second without dropping it or moving the clamp base.
comparison.reason: Tests precedence-sensitive clamp release and contact-verified retrieval. The record has no separate task spec or full numeric rubric beyond its body, but the available objective and central ability are clearly different from tang fracture and recovery.
